WITH filtered_executions AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    remaincount
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE expirespot BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
),
per_order_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    AVG(remaincount) as avg_remaincount,
    COUNT(*) as exec_count
  FROM filtered_executions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_remaincount) as avg_of_per_order_averages,
  SUM(exec_count) as total_execution_count
FROM per_order_stats
WHERE avg_remaincount IS NOT NULL;
